notes: Measured algorithm (pixel-exact vs AE 2026, 8 bpc): projective (perspective) homography taking the layer rectangle (0,0)-(W,H) onto the quad UL/UR/LR/LL, with pixel centres at INTEGER coordinates in both spaces (output pixel i has coordinate i, not i+0.5; the bilinear fit with .5 centres was off by ~0.15 px). Each output pixel is mapped back through the inverse homography and the layer is AREA-SAMPLED with an axis-aligned box centred on the mapped point whose size is the bounding box of the output pixel's footprint in the layer (width = |dsx/dx| + |dsx/dy|, height = |dsy/dx| + |dsy/dy|, analytic Jacobian of the inverse map), exact pixel coverage, transparent outside the layer: edge ramps measured 1.35 px wide on the slanted left edge and 1.15 px on top/bottom, exactly the L1 footprint (a hypot footprint or plain bilinear/bicubic are clearly worse: bilinear 0.13 mean / 2 % > 8). Plain round-to-nearest 8-bit output (a round-half-up bias measured worse). Default points (layer corners) = identity, bit-exact. Assumptions / not measured: magnification (footprint < 1 px) keeps a 1 px box (= bilinear) — the visible ref only has footprints 1.14..1.35; quads that are concave or self-intersecting (bow-tie) put the projective horizon inside the layer: points whose forward denominator is <= 0 are left transparent (AE's rendering of such quads unknown); boxes wider than 24 layer px per axis (quad < ~1/24 of the layer) use 12 evenly spaced bilinear taps per axis (approximate box, max 7 levels off vs the exact box); boxes up to 8x8 texels read texels with exact float weights, larger ones (<= 24 px) use the GPU bilinear filter to merge texel pairs (<= 144 taps). In AE the pinned layer can spill outside the layer bounds; here the output is clipped to the canvas (= layer) because the shader maps the whole canvas: the generated node's `pad` must stay 0 (with pad > 0 the points are offset by pad but the layer rectangle is taken as the padded canvas — fxlib passes no layer size/pad to Params). Not reproduced: AE 5 Compositing Options (effect opacity / effect masks).

measured.rive_vs_offline_extra: magnified (corners outside the layer), tiny 30x16 quad (24 px boxes), strong perspective: Rive vs offline mean <= 0.01, max 1; shader vs numpy exact-box model on identity / magnify / shrink / perspective / affine / mirrored quads: mean <= 0.0002, max 1
